a2-16.title: My English Essay
a2-16.story: This [[semester]], Anna is studying English on a big university [[campus]]. Her teacher asked the class to write a short [[essay]]. First, Anna read a [[text]] by her favorite [[author]]. It was [[fiction]], a story about a girl and her dog. She didn't know some words, so she guessed them from the [[context]]. In her writing, she used the [[adjective]] "brave" many times. Max said, "Try the [[comparative]] too, like 'braver than'!" He also showed her his [[method]] for checking spelling. Anna got a good grade and bought Max a coffee.

a2-17.title: Science Class
a2-17.story: Today Taras has a science class at school. His teacher draws a line one [[meter]] long on the board. Then she says, "A [[kilometer]] is a thousand of these lines." Next, they weigh apples, and one apple is about two hundred [[grams|gram]]. Five apples make one [[kilogram]], or one [[kilo]]. They also fill a big bottle with one [[liter]] of water. The teacher says everything, even water, is made of tiny [[atoms|atom]]. At home, Taras tells Mama about his day. "I want to be an [[astronaut]] and measure space!"

b1-01.title: At the Coffee Shop
b1-01.story: On Saturday morning, Anna and Max met at a small [[coffee shop]] near the university. The [[barista]], a friendly young man with glasses, smiled and asked what they wanted. Max ordered a strong [[espresso]] because he had stayed up late studying. Anna wanted a [[latte]] with vanilla [[syrup]], but they had run out of vanilla. So she chose a [[cappuccino]] instead and asked for a warm [[croissant]]. Max couldn't decide between a blueberry [[muffin]] and a slice of [[cheesecake]]. In the end, he took both and shared them with Anna. As they were leaving, they each got a free [[cupcake]] because it was the shop's birthday.

b1-02.title: Breakfast at Home
b1-02.story: On Monday morning, Anna's kitchen was very busy. Dad was frying [[bacon]] while the old [[toaster]] made loud clicking noises. Taras poured himself a big bowl of [[cornflakes]] and spilled some milk on the table. Mama spread [[margarine]] on her toast and cut an [[avocado]] in half. Anna put a banana, some strawberries and yogurt into the [[blender]] to make a [[smoothie]]. Taras wanted a chocolate [[milkshake]] too, but Mama said it was too early for that. Then Dad filled his [[thermos]] with hot coffee for the long drive to work. Everyone was almost ready when Taras shouted, "Where is my [[lunch box]]?" They found it in the fridge, right where he had left it the night before.

b1-03.title: Street Food Festival
b1-03.story: Last weekend, Lisa and Ira went to a [[street food]] festival in the park. The air smelled of smoke from a huge [[grill]] in the middle of the square. Ira bought a [[hot dog]] and covered it in [[ketchup]] and mustard. Lisa tried a spicy [[taco]] for the first time and loved it. Then she ordered a [[cheeseburger]] but asked the cook not to add [[mayonnaise]]. It still came with lots of it, so the cook kindly made a new one. Later they shared a big bag of [[popcorn]] and watched a band play. They walked home full and happy, already planning to come back next year.

b1-04.title: Pizza Night In
b1-04.story: On Friday evening, Anna invited Max and Sofia to her place for a movie night. Everyone was hungry, so they decided to order from the Italian [[pizzeria]] down the street. Max wanted a pizza with extra [[mozzarella]], and Sofia chose a Greek salad with [[feta]]. Anna ordered [[lasagna]] and a big piece of [[tiramisu]] for everyone to share. The app said the [[delivery]] would take forty minutes. While they waited, Anna cut a fresh [[baguette]] and put out some olive oil. When the food finally arrived, an hour late, it was still hot. Sofia laughed, "All that waiting has given me a huge [[appetite]]!"

b1-05.title: Cooking a Vegan Dinner
b1-05.story: Anna's friend Ira became a [[vegan]] last month, so Anna wanted to cook dinner for her. She found a recipe online and bought every [[ingredient]] at the market. The main dish was pasta with [[broccoli]] and fried [[zucchini]]. The recipe used cream, but Anna used coconut milk as a [[substitute]]. She set a [[timer]] for ten minutes so the pasta wouldn't get too soft. Then she made simple vegetable [[sushi]] with rice, avocado and cucumber. Ira tasted everything and said it was the best dinner she'd had in weeks.

b1-06.title: Grandpa's Night Out
b1-06.story: For Grandpa's seventieth birthday, the family went to an old [[pub]] in the city center. The friendly [[barman]] knew Grandpa well and gave him a small glass of [[brandy]]. Anna doesn't drink [[alcohol]], so she ordered apple juice with lots of ice. Next door there was a noisy [[cocktail bar]], and across the street a [[karaoke bar]]. At nine o'clock, a young [[DJ]] started playing old songs from the seventies. Grandpa laughed, "In my day, we called him a [[disc jockey]]!" Then he took Grandma's hand, and they danced like teenagers. Everyone clapped, and Grandpa said it was his best birthday ever.
